name: Dream Girlfriend: Doomer Girl
source:
[b]Sup, /b/. There's this girl...[/b]

So, last night, I decided to drag myself to the store to grab some smokes, and there I saw her – a real gem, a solid 10 out of 10, totally different from the rest. Beautiful, always rocking black, and she's a smoker too... Can't get her out of my head.

As for me, well, I'm just your typical downer, rarely leaving my cave except for a cig run. Most of the time, I'm just glued to my anime, you know, and other... stuff. A guy like me doesn't stand a chance with someone like her.

What's your take on this, anons? Should I keep going to that damn store every day, pretending to shop just to have an excuse to chat with her? But that's gonna drain my wallet, and it's not like I've got money to burn. Still, I just can't stop...

And if you were in my shoes, meeting your dream girl, what would you do?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2051080/]Steam[/url]]
